key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD smashed on growth scare; oil price surge hits Australia as net energy importer
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate-cut path
ANZ.AX axed 3,500 jobs; bank sector under structural cost pressure
Housing: high-end prices crashing while affordable segment resilient; no spring auction bounce
Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c/litre on global oil spike
Small-cap miners (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) and ASX runners (Iondrive, Aruma) showing relative strength
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy-security fears (Santos.AX relevant)

sectors.trend: Iron ore in active 'bloodletting' phase; large-cap miners (BHP, RIO, FMG) leading ASX losses. Small-cap gold and battery-tech names (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka, Critical Resources) bucking the trend.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term downside on weaker iron ore. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and battery/energy-transition names offer relative outperformance. Canaccord-led cap raises signal capital-raising pressure on small caps.

sectors.trend: Banks sending ASX tumbling alongside miners. ANZ.AX executing 3,500-job cut; structural margin pressure. RBA rental-inflation concern limits rate-cut expectations, pressuring NIMs.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face compressed earnings outlook. RBA's rental-inflation focus delays rate cuts, keeping funding costs elevated. Defensive dividend yield remains attractive but capital returns may slow.

sectors.trend: Oil 'explodes' as price-suppression fails; Australia softens gas supply rules easing Asian fears. Santos.AX preservation noted as national priority. Fuel prices to rise 30c.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX benefit from gas policy flexibility. However, higher oil/fuel costs inflate import bill, weighing on consumer and transport sectors. LNG export competitiveness supported.

sectors.trend: Woolworths (WES.AX) raised 'family staple' prices during Price Freeze promo; fuel costs rising; Australian businesses 'fear for their future'. Consumer spending under pressure.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CPL.AX face margin squeeze from input costs vs. pricing power limits. Consumer discretionary names vulnerable. Defensive staples preferred.

sectors.trend: Housing prices crashing at high end; affordable segment resilient. No spring auction bounce. RBA watching rental inflation. Property chiefs calling for more migrants to address supply gap.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face mixed signals: falling asset values vs. rental inflation support. First-home-buyer surge may support construction (WTC.AX, MDS.AX). High-end residential REITs most exposed.

sectors.trend: Limited direct ASX healthcare headlines; global GLP-1 (Eli Lilly) and AI-security (Zscaler) themes active. ASX tech names (Neurizon) among weekly runners.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. AI/tech small caps (Neurizon, Iondrive) showing momentum but illiquid. Global AI-security theme relevant to ASX-listed cyber names.

key_themes: Oil surge + iron ore decline = dual squeeze on Australian terms of trade
AUD weakness amplifies import-cost inflation, complicating RBA policy
RBA rental-inflation focus delays rate cuts, pressuring banks and property
Housing bifurcation: high-end correction vs. affordable resilience
Superannuation reform debate intensifying (populism vs. structural integrity)
Small-cap mining cap-raise wave signals capital stress in junior sector
Energy policy shift (gas supply rules) supports LNG exporters

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX exposure; rotate into gold and energy-transition miners
Hedge fuel exposure; favour domestic energy producers (Santos.AX, WDS.AX) over importers
Underweight rate-sensitive REITs and property developers; favour fixed-income and dividend payers
AUD weakness benefits exporters (miners, agribusiness) but hurts importers; monitor AUD/USD for 0.60 support
Avoid high-end residential REITs; monitor auction clearance rates and first-home-buyer data
Avoid pre-announcement cap-raise names; favour cash-flow-positive juniors

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight domestic energy producers on gas policy flexibility
opportunities.rationale: Softened gas supply rules support LNG export volumes; oil surge lifts upstream margins

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into gold and battery-tech miners as iron ore weakens
opportunities.rationale: Gold 'schmould' but safe-haven bid on growth scare; battery tech (Critical Resources) in month-long validation

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive dividend exposure via CSL and staples
opportunities.rationale: Market in risk-off mode; CSL.AX and WES.AX offer income and relative resilience

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; BHP/RIO/FMG face 10-15% downside risk into Q4

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight high-end residential REITs and property developers
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at top end; RBA rate-cut delay prolongs correction

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness with commodity-linked or export-revenue assets
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'smashed' on growth scare; exporters benefit from weaker currency

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to test lower supports as oil surge, iron ore weakness, and AUD depreciation compound. RBA's rental-inflation focus limits rate-cut catalyst. Expect 3-5% further downside in ^AXJO over 1-3 months unless oil stabilises. Small caps and gold offer relative outperformance.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if iron ore stabilises and RBA pivots to cuts by Q1 2027. Housing bifurcation (high-end correction, affordable resilience) suggests no systemic crash. Energy policy reform supports LNG sector. Superannuation reform debate may create policy tailwinds for financials. Key risk: prolonged global growth scare.
key_catalysts: RBA September/November rate decision and rental-inflation commentary
Iron ore price trajectory (PSI index) and China stimulus signals
Oil price resolution / OPEC+ policy response
ANZ.AX cost-cutting execution and margin recovery
watch_list: Iron ore 62% Fe price (PSI) – key threshold at USD 90/t
Brent crude and Australian domestic fuel prices
RBA cash rate and rental inflation data (ABS)
CoreLogic / SQM housing price indices (high-end vs. median)
BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX quarterly production guidance
ANZ.AX, CBA.AX NIM and cost-to-income trends
